[[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sister]] [[Charal]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]],<ref name="WSWFG" /> a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|women]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]],<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref> wore a type of '''armor'''. Consisting of a distinctive metal [[Armor/Legends|breastplate]],<ref name="WSWFG" /> the personal armor<ref name="BFE" /> was used as bodily protection.<ref name="SWG9" /> This breastplate was segmented and secured by laces attached at the wearer's back.<ref name="BFE" /> She often wore the armor in conjunction with a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[grafiform]] [[Robe/Legends|robe]] and a feathered [[Cape/Legends|cape]].<ref name="WSWFG" />

Whenever Charal,<ref name="BFE" /> who was stranded on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] about a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> [[Metamorphosis|shapeshifted]] into a [[Raven/Legends|raven]] using the [[Talisman of Transformation|artifact]] known as the [[Talisman of the Raven]], her armor disappeared until she transformed back into [[Human/Legends|Human]] form.<ref name="BFE" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' dates the events of ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]'' to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].</ref> the [[Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] destroyed Charal's talisman by shooting it with an [[arrow]], and the Nightsister was permanently turned into a raven, leading to a final disappearance of her set of armor, as well.<ref name="BFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Charal's armor first appeared in the [[1985]] television film ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''.<ref name="BFE" /> Its design was developed by director and artist [[Joe Johnston]].<ref name="ISWU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> Contrary to its original depiction as a segmented armor set,<ref name="BFE" /> the [[2003]] [[Sony]] Online Entertainment [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', depicted Charal's armor as a single plate of metal adorned with mystical carvings.<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Charal|Endor}}</ref>
